تتصاعدون (form VI)
# تَتَصَاعَدُونَ (tataṣāʕadūna) /ta.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# تُتَصَاعَدُونَ (tutaṣāʕadūna) /tu.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
